families.page_title: Aluminium: health effects and incident management
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on aluminium for use when responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 1 July 2014.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 8 January 2025.
The publication provides general information and incident management material.
The linked material supports substance-specific assessment of health effects, exposure and incident response for aluminium.
The source provides substance-specific incident-response information rather than treating all chemical events as equivalent.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained the title “Aluminium: health effects and incident management”.
